limitations: The ROMDIR record layout and extinfo envelope fields are cross-checked against PS2SDK source and this image; other IOPRP variants are not tested.
No replacement, edited growth, runtime module loading, relocation application, dependency graph, or module semantics are validated.

scope: Inventory of all standalone MODULES/*.IRX;1 files and the IOPRP300.IMG;1 image listed by the pinned disc inventory. DVP overlays and executable semantics are outside this report.

source_evidence.leaf_verification: For each listed standalone module and IOPRP image, bytes read directly from its ISO LBA match the extracted workspace leaf and the SHA-256 in reports/disc.json.
source_evidence.section_verification: Standalone ELF section headers were decoded from source bytes, matched to the existing per-module JSON reports, and file-backed section hashes were recomputed.

standalone_irx_summary.note: EM_MIPS and e_flags=0x1 are observed ELF metadata. Host readelf describes the flags as MIPS-I; this does not recover source, loader behavior, or module runtime semantics.
